summary: use canonical repository URI in local allocation leases

delivery.outcome: Generate canonical, schema-valid local allocation leases: derive repositoryRef as owner/repository from an origin URL, or local/<sha256> from the primary checkout when no origin exists; keep the local checkout basename separate for Worktrees v5 layout planning.
nonGoals: No migration or mutation of historical malformed leases.
No changes to change-lease schema semantics.
No ticket number or worktree naming changes.

architecture.decision: Separate canonical lease repository identity from local filesystem layout label; share the existing URL normalizer and derive clone-local identity through its sibling function.
architecture.rollback: Revert allocator and regression changes; do not rewrite historical lease records.

validation.evidence: Origin-backed fixture creates owner/repository repositoryRef; layout label remains local.
Origin-less fixture creates local/<sha256>; both generated leases pass canonical change-lease validation.
Ticket changed-file governance passes on the exact implementation scope.
